title: Support filtering GET /books by author and tag
body:
Clients need to filter the catalogue:

- `GET /books?author=martin` → books whose author contains the text (case-insensitive)
- `GET /books?tag=craft` → books that have exactly that tag
- both filters can be combined; with no filters the full list is returned as today.

Please add tests.
plan:
Implement filtering for GET /books by author and tag in the server route.
1. Modify the GET /books route handler to filter by author and tag
2. Add tests for filtering functionality
requirements: GET /books?author=martin returns books whose author contains 'martin' (case-insensitive)
GET /books?tag=craft returns books with the exact tag 'craft'
GET /books?author=martin&tag=craft returns books by author 'martin' with tag 'craft'
GET /books returns the full list when no filters are specified
Add tests for the new filtering functionality.
